If you’re in Cat Ba, don’t miss this place. Excellent food, great vibe.
Mar 2026 • Couples
Some of the best food we’ve had in 9 weeks of travelling. 
We popped into The Healing Kitchen for lunch and were blown away by the extensive menu. This place serves the most amazing vegetarian, vegan, seafood and duck dishes. We had the tuna poke bowl and duck salad. The chef here works miracles with fresh ingredients bringing out the flavours of everything they cook with. 
The poke bowl was refreshing and full of flavours. The tuna was beautifully cooked too.
Each mouthful of the fruit in the duck salad was bursting with flavours. The greens were perfectly complement by the sweet dressing. 

This place deserves its 5 out of 5 rating. Make sure you don’t miss it when in Cat Ba.
